packageRules.description: Chainguard base image: keep the pinned digest fresh (zero-CVE rebuilds). Each bump is a PR the Trivy gate must pass. minimumReleaseAge waits out a compromised push even from a trusted vendor; the weekly cadence keeps drift small. (Set to false here if you'd rather take base CVE fixes instantly.)
npm deps: wait 7 days before adopting a new release to dodge malicious/compromised fresh publishes; batch into one weekly PR.
GitHub Actions (CI workflows): one grouped PR instead of per-action noise; still 7-day-aged to wait out a compromised action release. No schedule so the initial digest-pinning consolidates promptly.
